content.title: Opinion | Repealing the Jones Act is 106 years overdue - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessThe Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it will suspend the Jones Act for 60 days to reduce fuel prices. It’s a good start.The Jones Act says that any vessel carrying goods between United States ports must be U.S.-built, U.S.-owned, U.S.-flagged and U.S.-crewed. Given that shipping is one of the most globalized industries, few of the world’s ships meet those requirements.What readers are sayingThe conversation explores the complexities and controversies surrounding the Jones Act, a federal statute aimed at supporting the U.S. Merchant Marine.
